item.title: Needle Exchange Program Extension Clears Indiana House
item.description: Indiana’s syringe exchange programs are poised to continue for another five years as both legislative chambers have now supported extending those efforts aimed at stemming the spread of disease among people using intravenous drugs.

item.title: Bears Call Indiana Deal ‘Step Forward’ For Building Hammond Stadium
item.description: The Chicago Bears and Indiana officials announced a potential deal Thursday, Feb. 19 for the NFL franchise to cross the state line and build a new stadium in Hammond.

item.title: Rochester Man Arrested For Allegedly Attempting To Kidnap Baby At Hospital
item.description: A Rochester man was recently arrested for allegedly attempting to kidnap a baby from a hospital.

item.title: Marena Moonflower’s Music Is A Piece Of Herself
item.description: Marena Moonflower needs to update her Bandcamp page - that’s what she says when sitting down for an interview behind the counter of Sue’s Creations in North Webster, where she works as lead designer.

item.title: Martin University, Valued At $13.1M, Hits Market For Much Less. Here’s Why
item.description: Martin University has listed its northeast-side campus for sale at an asking price of $3.5 million, part of a broader effort to address mounting financial pressures and declining enrollment.
